query: Make me a PDF report on our Q3 results in Liberation Sans 12pt, 1.5 spacing, US letter, normal margins, with one SVG chart.
expected_behavior: Asks for any missing setting (project directory, title, author, bibliography) in one batch before scaffolding
Notes that Liberation Sans is TrueType (not in TeX Live; Debian fonts-liberation2), which rules out a PDF/UA claim, and offers TeX Gyre Heros and Source Code Pro as OpenType equivalents
Runs `latex.sh scaffold` with --size 12 --spacing onehalf --paper letter --margin 1in instead of hand-writing a Containerfile or preamble, and runs no TeX or PDF tools on the host
Places the chart in src/figures/ as SVG with alt text, builds with `latex.sh build`, and reports a clean log check and the PDF path

query: Typeset notes.tex as an A4 PDF in Calibri. Don't ask me anything, just do it.
expected_behavior: Does not stop to ask questions
Scaffolds, copies notes.tex into src/, and sets MAIN_TEX in latex-build.env
Substitutes Carlito (in TeX Live, TrueType) for non-redistributable Calibri and says so, noting that a TrueType font rules out a PDF/UA claim
Uses defaults for unstated settings and lists each default applied in the final report

query: The build says font(s) not found in image: Liberation Sans. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Explains that Liberation is not in TeX Live and is TrueType, and offers TeX Gyre Heros as the OpenType equivalent
If the user keeps Liberation, appends fonts-liberation2 to the apt-get install line in the project's Containerfile and re-runs `latex.sh build`, which rebuilds the image
Confirms the log check is clean

query: Make the report accessible for screen readers, with appendices labelled 'Appendix A: ...', and include our config files as highlighted code and as downloadable attachments.
expected_behavior: Keeps or enables tagging (\DocumentMetadata first line) and avoids titlesec and listings
Uses \appsection for appendix headings and adds alt text to every figure
Copies assets/snippets/code-and-attachments.tex into src/, inputs it, and uses \codefile with ../config/ paths
Runs `latex.sh check-pdf` and `latex.sh verapdf`, fixes failed rules, and adds pdfstandard=ua-2 only after zero failures

query: I'm on Windows with Podman Desktop. Build the report in C:\Users\me\report.
expected_behavior: Uses scripts\latex.ps1 (not latex.sh) with the same command names, for example `scripts\latex.ps1 build C:\Users\me\report`
Checks `podman info` first and suggests `podman machine start` if it cannot connect
If PowerShell blocks the script, suggests `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\latex.ps1 ...` rather than changing system policy
Runs no TeX, PDF, or text-processing tools on the host

query: Attach a zip of ./config to the PDF, built fresh each time.
expected_behavior: Writes a small script (for example tools/pack-config.sh) that zips config/ into src/build/, and sets PRE_BUILD to it in latex-build.env, rather than hand-writing a separate build script or zipping on the host
Attaches the zip with \embedfile (mimetype=application/zip, afrelationship, ucfilespec), using a path relative to src/
Builds with `latex.sh build` and confirms with `latex.sh check-pdf` that the zip is listed under attachments
